body.body_html: Superseded by #6 — the branch was renamed to alinhamento/2026-09, which closed this PR.

body.body:
Closing as superseded. This function was written for an earlier model, in which a proposal passed through "DAOs or councils" chosen by purpose. There are no DAOs in the current design, and councils are not chosen from a fixed set.

The current model:

- A member council is formed for one question. There are no standing councils, fixed seats or fixed domains.
- It is convened by members, or by Dk when its certainty about a decision is low. Whoever convenes it takes part.
- Dknowledge composes it from the best informed on the question and the most affected by it, and Dk takes part in the middle of it.
- There are no DAOs. DAF is an autonomous federation of autonomous units and a basic and primitive form of PAP, implemented now on GitHub (Phase 0): its rules, instruments and public record exist. No unit has been recorded and no assembly has been held yet.

Current documentation: [Advices](https://advices.drayker.org), [GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/draykerdk/.github/blob/master/GOVERNANCE.md), [DFMP](https://dfmp.drayker.org) and [DAF](https://daf.drayker.org). New open functions will be written against this model.
